messages.subject: Kingsmoor - pre-contract enquiries (CPSE.1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Zoe,

Our CPSE.1 enquiries are in the data room. In particular please confirm: (1) the status of the Aldermere rent review; (2) the Brookmere service-charge query on the 2024 lift refurbishment; and (3) the management contract with Brookfield FM and whether TUPE is engaged. Grateful for replies before exchange.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
